messages.subject: Problem in plotdif
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to do DIF (differential item functioning tests) in my data, and I used the sintax from 'mirt' help, like this:

set.seed(12345)
a1 <- a2 <- matrix(abs(rnorm(15,1,.3)), ncol=1)
d1 <- d2 <- matrix(rnorm(15,0,.7),ncol=1)
a2[1:2, ] <- a1[1:2, ]/3
d1[c(1,3), ] <- d2[c(1,3), ]/4
head(data.frame(a.group1 = a1, a.group2 = a2, d.group1 = d1, d.group2 = d2))
itemtype <- rep('dich', nrow(a1))
N <- 1000
dataset1 <- simdata(a1, d1, N, itemtype)
dataset2 <- simdata(a2, d2, N, itemtype, mu = .1, sigma = matrix(1.5))
dat <- rbind(dataset1, dataset2)
group <- c(rep('D1', N), rep('D2', N))

#  Information matrix with crossprod
model <- multipleGroup(dat, 1, group, SE = TRUE)

#test whether adding slopes and intercepts constraints results in DIF. Plot items showing DIF
resulta1d <- DIF(model, c('a1', 'd'), plotdif = TRUE)

However, the last line did not worked... 
Error in print(plot(MGmodel, type = type, which.items = which.item, facet_items = TRUE,  : 
  erro na avaliação do argumento 'x' na seleção do método para a função 'print': 'Error: (list) object cannot be coerced to type 'integer

Could you help me, please?

Thanks a lot!


Danilo
Brazil
